lap_length_note: Approximate. GPS path length varies about 811–834 m by session. The 2026-10-17 note compared that day's laps (~811–820 m) with prior session B (~834 m). CSV path lengths: E about 816–850 m (one lap 849.5), F about 807–821 m.
segments_note: Metres after the timing line, same gates as the 2026-10-17 analysis. Three small full-throttle kinks are treated as straights. 15 segments = 8 corners + 7 straights. T2 runs straight into T3, and T5 runs straight into T6 (no straight gate between those pairs).
